title: shipping-service outage due to DB connection pool exhaustion
summary: A caching feature deployed to shipping-service introduced a code path that opened a new database connection on every write but never released it back to the pool. Within minutes of deployment, the connection pool was fully exhausted (100/100 connections in use), causing requests to fail with 500 errors.
root_cause: The new logic acquired a DB connection but never explicitly released it back to the pool after use, since the code assumed a context manager would handle it automatically. It did not.
fix: Wrapped connection acquisition in a proper context manager to guarantee release even on exceptions, and added a pool utilization alert at 80% to catch this class of bug earlier.
